AGVs can operate in three different modes. The current mode is displayed in the top bar of the application :
AUTOMATIC MODE - AGV is managed by Qursor M.A.P. system,
MANUAL MODE - AGV is controlled using the touch-screen or remotely by the AGV HMI mobile application on condition that the safety bumper in the AGV is continuously pressed.
SETUP MODE - is a service mode used during the commissioning, deployment, on-site integration or diagnostics of AGVs. This mode is intended for AIUT service operators and should not be used during the regular operation of the AGV.

AGV safety sensors surround the area and slow down or stop if an obstacle is detected. The sensors can detect people or objects in the path of the AGV, what protects the personnel and helps to avoid the mechanical damage of the AGV.
The safety scanners have two safety fields marked with colours:
YELLOW - an obstacle is detected in the warning zone, AGV slows down to the safe speed.
RED - an obstacle is detected in the emergency zone, AGV stops immediately
The ultrasonic scanners help the AGV to locate in its
environment and calculate the distance to the obstacle.

text:
Kanbans consist of one or more steps. Each step is a list of jobs to be executed in a specific sequence. Each job is composed of specified preconditions (Conditions) that must be met in order to execute the command (use case)*. After the conditions are met, the use case is triggered, and the system moves on to the next job.
Individual steps are triggered either by operators or by an external system using the Qursor API. After completing a step, which means executing all jobs in its sequence, Qursor waits for the next step to be called.
* It is also possible for a job to have no preconditions.
The list of current Kanbans is displayed in the dashboard  view of the application. Details on the next page.

All zones ID created in Qursor Configurator must be mapped with zoneID in Navithor map. This is done in the Qursor Fleet Manager configuration file - zones.json . Zones have assigned areas - groups of points that trigger a request to block the zone when AGV meets them.

 zones section - links zoneID points from Navithor Tools map with zone created in Qursor Configurator.
